Name: Smoothen
Description: Applies a power curve followed by smoothstep, with an optional absolute-value step and no upward value overshoot.

Params.Name: Exponent
Params.Label: Exponent
Params.Description: Power applied to each input value before smoothstep.
Params.Tooltip: Values above 1 push values in the 0-1 range toward zero. The final result never exceeds the processed input.

Params.Name: Abs
Params.Label: Absolute input
Params.Description: Applies absolute value before raising the input to the exponent.
Params.Tooltip: Useful when the sign should not affect the power operation.
